Name: Wright Brothers' Mysteries
Overview:
A fun interactive multipath full motion visual novel

We follow two crime-solving brothers (Cade and Evan Wright) who investigate a robbery at Granny Franny's house, where the thief inadvertently leaves behind a clue that provides a key lead, and You have to help them solve the mystery from there while going to various locations and gathering clues.

Gameplay primarily consists of watching full-motion video cutscenes, with interactive elements in between, players make choices at certain points, which alter the storyline.
